_comment: The founder's approved Pixabay tracks (Pixabay Content License), shipped ONLY as WAHALA!'s in-game soundtrack, never as a standalone collection (see public/audio/LICENSES.md). Nothing generated may ever be listed here (tests/audio/assets.test.ts). `artist` is the Pixabay uploader as named in the downloaded file; `gain` levels every track to about -14 LUFS (measured with ffmpeg ebur128). A listed file that is not present (pixabay_496406) is skipped at runtime. Each standard arena has ONE signature track (founder assignment, decision N12); The classic City Rumble district rotates a five-track subset; each of the five V2 Rumble stages has ONE signature track (supplied 2026-10-25). See docs/AUDIO.md.
